summary: Bus-route kerb with little parking; houses about 10-11 m behind it.
reasons: Only a few cars park here

drivers.seclusion: Nearest dwellings are about 11 m away at 56 m along and 10 m away at 6 m along; the section is a few metres clear of both but houses and fences line the whole back edge.
drivers.access_and_room: Footpath and narrow verge beside a sealed lane; a van can pull in where other cars park, but room is limited.
drivers.traffic: Through road with a bus in the imagery; steady traffic.
drivers.convention: No signs mapped. A few cars park at the kerb near 50 m and 105 m, so a van is not unique, but parking is thin.

flags: Homes about 10 m away on the same side
Bus route and through traffic noise
Steep further along: max grade 11.6% towards the far end
No parking signs to confirm legality
sun_shade: Open to sun at the east end; trees over the road to the south-west give some afternoon shade.
cannot_judge: Whether the kerb is wide enough to stop fully clear of the lane

best_section.where: North kerb of Stanley Terrace, between the east-end houses and the white-roofed house, backed by fences and trees
